channel.title: WSJ.com: Markets
channel.description: Markets news from the Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
item.description: Gold and silver futures settled lower as traders positioned ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision.

item.title: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
item.description: The market reaction to DeepSeek was severe, but the economics of AI infrastructure spending remain intact.
